Class.name: IHC.ITF.Operation.TransTrackRemitCffJdbc
Class.Description: This class has method to call the select heatlh Stored procedures and also generate the EFT file if call is successful

Parameter.name: ADAPTER
Parameter.Description: This class is used to write the EDIFEC data from Oracle server to a file

Property.name: SuccessReturnCodes
Property.Description: Values that can be returned by stored procedure. values separated by , Response code = 0 -- Row successfully updated Response code = 100 -- Row update failed because we did not find the CheckRef # in the database. We want to continue processing

Method.name: OnMessage
Method.Description: This method calls Select Health Stored procedure DND.IHCPK_DND_CORE_ERA.IHCSP_DND_CORE_ERA_SENT to store trans tracking
